production.note: US model years. The second-generation car starts with the 2019 model (Mercedes-Benz USA '2019 Mercedes-AMG G63 Specifications'). Still on sale: mbusa.com lists the 2027 AMG G 63 at 577 hp (mbusa-2027-g63). The earlier W463 G 63 (2013 to 2018 model years) is a different car.

fuel.note: Gasoline V8. From the 2025 model year an integrated starter-generator was added (mbusa.com 2027: 'Handcrafted AMG 4.0L V8 biturbo with hybrid assist'; Motor1, motor1-2025-g63-review: 'an integrated starter generator (ISG) that adds up to 20 hp'); it is a mild hybrid, so the fuel stays Gasoline.

drivetrain.note: 'Permanent four-wheel drive (40 : 60)'. Permanent system, so AWD under the guide.

transmission.note: '9G-TRONIC 9-speed automatic transmission' (later called AMG SPEEDSHIFT TCT 9G)

powerHp.note: Quote: "Horsepower @ rpm | 577 @ 6,000". Unchanged through the 2027 model year: mbusa.com "577 hp @ 6,000 rpm" (mbusa-2027-g63); the ISG from 2025 adds a temporary boost not included in the rating.

weightLb.note: US curb weight, 2019 model, the only transmission. Quote: "Curb Weight | 5,842" (lb).
